source_context_review: The exact law permits operation on roadway, bicycle lane, path or route at no more than 15 mph except as otherwise provided by an applicable ordinance. This frozen cycle_path cell targets a path. The witness additionally requires handlebars, electric motor, riding design, propulsion, mass <=100 lb excluding rider and motor-only maximum <=20 mph, with assistive-device intent review where the local definition applies. Local facility permission alone does not establish a replacement operating speed.

ru.electric_scooter.evidence: Original scooter blueprint and rider identity, handlebars, electric motor, riding design, propulsion, rider-excluded mass and motor-only maximum sources; classification is distinct from speed limit.
